PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  March 28, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, March 28, 2019,
at 2:02 pm in the City Council Chambers, 9th Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer – 2:09 pm
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department
  Serena Martinez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Councilman Eloy Morales to host District 3 Re-Opening of Ashwood Park
  and Family Day at Ashwood Park, 201 S. Ash Ave., May 11, 2019, from
  11:00 am – 4:00 pm, subject to Public Works providing a detailed
  encroachment permit, specifying exact street closures; tentatively, 1
  sergeant, 4 uniformed officers and 4 traffic control officers is required to be
  staffed, final number of staffing is to be determined; watch commander will
  be notified; maintain site at all times , ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; adhere to all applicable IMC rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00274445)

Item #2:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for Daniel Kash; dba: LAX Firing Range to operate a firing range
  at 921 W. Manchester Blvd, subject to payment of business license and tax
  renewal fees; provide copies of valid government-issued identification for
  business owner and all employee, state and federal license/certifications,
  including any and all certifications from instructional training class;
  possession or sales of firearms and/or ammunition to an unauthorized
  person is prohibited by law; possession or sales of any illegal and/or
  unauthorized firearms, ammunition or explosives is strictly prohibited;
  locations at 927 W. Manchester Blvd. and 234 S. Hindry Ave., are subject
  to random inspections by an police, law enforcement, fire or code
  enforcement officials at any time during hours of operation; adhere to all
  applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and signage, local,
